Job Summary

Senior Test Automation Engineer

We are seeking a skilled Senior Test Automation Engineer to join our dynamic technology team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust automated test suites across API and UI layers for mission-critical trading and financial applications, ensuring quality, reliability, and regulatory compliance across our global financial market business.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation Strategy & Design

  • Design and implement scalable, maintainable automated test frameworks covering API, UI (web), and end-to-end (E2E) test layers
  • Translate business requirements and acceptance criteria into layered test strategies (unit / API / UI / E2E) and BDD-style Gherkin feature files
  • Define test data strategy, environment management, and test coverage standards aligned with product risk profile

Development & Implementation

  • Build and maintain automated test suites using industry-standard frameworks (e.g. Cucumber/BDD, Playwright, Selenium, REST-assured)
  • Implement API-level automation validating request/response contracts, business rules, and data integrity
  • Implement UI/E2E automation validating critical user journeys across web applications
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines for continuous execution and fast feedback

Technical Excellence

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented test code and glue logic following established coding standards
  • Participate in code reviews of test automation assets and contribute to continuous improvement of test practices
  • Triage test failures, distinguish flaky tests from genuine defects, and drive root-cause resolution
  • Stay current with emerging test automation tools, frameworks, and industry best practices

Collaboration & Communication

  • Work closely with backend developers, frontend developers, SRE, BAs, product managers, and business stakeholders to embed quality throughout the SDLC
  • Participate in agile development processes including sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives
  • Contribute to technical documentation, test reports, and knowledge sharing initiatives
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and share automation expertise across the team

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure test coverage meets defined quality gates (e.g. minimum coverage thresholds) before releases
  • Support regression, smoke, and release-readiness testing across test/UAT/production environments
  • Ensure automated tests validate security, data integrity, and regulatory requirements where applicable
  • Participate in defect management, root-cause analysis, and continuous test process improvement

Skills And Experience

  • Test Automation Framework (BDD/Cucumber preferred)
  • UI Automation (Playwright, Selenium)
  • API Automation (REST-assured / Postman)
  • Programming Language (Java or TypeScript)
  • CI/CD Integration (Azure DevOps, Jenkins)
  • Build & Packaging Tools (Maven, npm)
  • Test Automation Framework (BDD/Cucumber preferred)

Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 3-8 years of experience in software test automation or SDET roles
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language used for test automation (Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python)
  • Hands-on experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow) and Gherkin feature file authoring
  • Hands-on experience with UI automation frameworks (Playwright, Selenium, Cypress)
  • Hands-on experience with API automation frameworks (REST-assured, Postman/Newman, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent)
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs, HTTP protocols, and asynchronous testing patterns
  • Experience with build/dependency tools (Maven, Gradle, npm)
  • Knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools (Azure DevOps Test Plans, Jira/Xray, or equivalent)

Professional Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality
  • Proactive approach to learning and professional development

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Banking or financial services domain knowledge advantageous

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience testing distributed/microservice architectures (REST + gRPC + WebSocket)
  • Understanding of banking/financial services domain, particularly FX/trading systems
  • Experience with performance/load testing tools (JMeter, k6, Gatling)
  • Exposure to AI-assisted test generation or BDD-driven development pipelines

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

The Corporate Salesperson is a strategic professional who stays abreast of developments within own field and contributes to directional strategy by considering their application in own job and the business. Recognized technical authority for an area within the business. Requires basic commercial awareness. There are typically multiple people within the business that provide the same level of subject matter expertise. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Significant impact on the area through complex deliverables. Provides advice and counsel related to the technology or operations of the business. Work impacts an entire area, which eventually affects the overall performance and effectiveness of the sub-function/job family.

Responsibilities:

  • Sell separate account services or finance products directly to Corporate clients
  • Will help team to service clients in the buying and selling of securities, derivatives, FX and commodities
  • Help drive the team's developed strategy across specified product lines
  • Aid to achieve specified goals in both market and wallet share for the identified client franchise
  • Originate and execute meaningful and landmark transactions
  • Will independently and/or jointly work within business product to achieve the strategic growth and market share we are aiming for
  • Partner closely with other key businesses and functions to ensure proper product deployment based on understanding of client
  • Help foster an environment of collaboration through interfacing with appropriate internal partners to enhance share of mind with clients, increase dialogue and to deliver on expertise
  • Understand and analyze clients’ businesses and exposures to provide best suited sales solutions in full coordination with all relevant business partners
  • Work in close partnership with control functions such as Legal, Compliance, Market and Credit Risk, Audit, Finance in order to ensure appropriate governance and control infrastructure
  • Build a culture of responsible finance, good governance and supervision, expense discipline and ethics
  • Appropriately assess risk/reward of transactions when making business decisions; demonstrating proper consideration for the firm’s reputation.
  • Be familiar with and adhere to Citi’s Code of Conduct and the Plan of Supervision for Global Markets and Securities Services
  • Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

  • Previous experience in client-facing roles with proven track record on growing and maintaining relationships through value added service and commercial skills

Principal Responsibilities

As an Application Developer within Institutional Bank Group, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and implementing innovative software solutions. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Software Development: Developing, testing, and deploying high-quality, scalable, and resilient applications, utilizing modern programming languages and frameworks.
  • Generative AI and Machine Learning: Engaging in the development and integration of Generative AI (GenAI) and Machine Learning (ML) models into financial applications, contributing to advanced analytical and predictive capabilities. This may involve working with GenAI/ML platforms and leveraging services.
  • System Design and Architecture: Participating in the architectural design of new and existing systems, ensuring they meet business requirements and adhere to best practices in terms of performance, security, and scalability.
  • DevOps and CI/CD: Implementing and maintaining Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to automate software delivery processes, ensuring efficient and reliable deployments.
  • Collaboration: Working closely with product managers and product owners to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Troubleshooting and Support: Providing technical support and troubleshooting for production issues, ensuring high availability and performance of critical applications.
  • Documentation: Creating and maintaining comprehensive technical documentation for applications and systems.
  • Innovation: Staying abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, particularly in areas like AI/ML, cloud computing, and financial technology, to drive continuous improvement and innovation within the team.

Education And Relevant Experience

  • 5+ years of working experience with Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in Java, familiar with Python.
  • Proven experience in software development, preferably within the financial services industry.
  • Solid understanding of relational and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with middle ware service like Kafka, RocketMQ etc.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP, OCP) and cloud-native application development.
  • Experience with DevOps principles and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).
  • Experience with scripting languages like Bash, sh, etc. Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments.
  • Knowledge of financial markets products and processes is highly desirable.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in an agile, fast-paced, and collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Front-end development experience (e.g., Angular, JavaScript, React) is a plus for full-stack roles.
  • Prior professional experience in FinTech, Top tier banking industry

  • Take lead in designing the solution which is more reusable and maintainable.
  • Apply an AI software development lifecycle (AI SDLC) approach covering data readiness, model selection/build, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
  • Assist the delivery of AI-enabled features (e.g., assisted servicing, intelligent search, personalisation, summarisation, advisor/ops copilots) ensuring measurable business
  • Accountable for ensuring the design of the product solutions are cost effective and maintained through the agile development lifecycle, managing the flow of the backlog of design activities.
  • Breaking down the system functions into multiple-tier API layers and micro services
  • Provides accurate estimates and status to management, raising issues appropriately.
  • Ensure that development is done with the highest quality measured by defect counts and defect ratios
  • Provide Application incident on-call support during off business hours, and provide Weekend/Public Holiday Application Support per project delivery and Business needs.

Requirements

  • A minimum of 5 years' IT software development experiences with strong experience in Java 8 or above, Spring, Restful Services, Spring Boot and micro-service based architectures.
  • A track record of delivering change on architecting, implementing, and supporting enterprise-grade technical solutions, preferably in a financial institution.
  • Good understanding of both RDBMS & NoSQL databases technologies such as Oracle, Postgres, MongoDB, Redis or equivalent.
  • Experience of containerization, ideally using Docker / Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on technical expertise, acquired through delivering Cloud technologies (GCP, AWS and / or Azure) into a large enterprise.
  • Experience building and deploying AI/ML or LLM-powered applications in production (e.g., RAG, intelligent search, classification, summarisation, recommendations).
  • Knowledge of AI SDLC concepts: data preparation, evaluation, model/prompt versioning, deployment strategies, monitoring and retraining/refresh cycles.
  • Strong experience in DevOps tools such as Git, Jenkins, Nexus, Maven or equivalent.
  • Good understanding with messaging services such IBM MQ, Kafka or equivalent.
  • Strong work ethic and team player experienced working with Scrum/Agile development methodologies
  • Real passion for elegance and efficiency in software engineering and always strive for continuous improvements via automated processes
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills and fluent in English

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business: Asia & Middle East Technology

Job ID: 53883

Principal Responsibilities

Quality Strategy & Delivery

  • Define and implement test strategy, test plans, quality gates, and release entry/exit criteria (DoR/DoD).
  • Manage testing scope, priorities, resourcing and timelines; proactively identify risks and drive mitigation actions.
  • Own defect management end-to-end: triage, prioritisation, root cause analysis (RCA), prevention actions, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure appropriate test coverage across functional, regression, integration and end-to-end testing; coordinate performance/security testing where relevant.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, coach and develop QA engineers; provide clear direction, feedback and performance support.
  • Establish and maintain testing standards: test design, reviews, traceability, test data and environment practices.
  • Support hiring and upskilling (e.g., automation, performance, SDETs) aligned to the team’s roadmap.

Automation & Quality Engineering

  • Build and maintain automated testing across API/UI/Integration layers to reduce manual effort and accelerate delivery.
  • Embed testing into CI/CD pipelines (smoke/regression, reporting, alerts) and promote shift-left practices.
  • Partner with DevOps/platform teams to improve test environment stability, test data strategy, and observability (logs/metrics/traces).

Stakeholder Management & Reporting

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Operations and business stakeholders to align quality expectations and acceptance criteria.
  • Provide transparent quality reporting to leadership (risk, defect trends, pass rates, coverage, release readiness) and support informed go/no-go decisions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (Computer Science, Software Engineering or related discipline preferred).
  • 10+ years in QA/testing/quality engineering, including 2+ years in a Test Lead/QA Lead role.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC/STLC, test design techniques, risk-based testing, and agile delivery.
  • Hands-on experience in UI test automation using Java / Appium / Selenium
  • Solid API testing automation experience (e.g., RestAssured, pytest, Postman/Newman, Karate).
  • CI/CD and test pipeline integration (e.g. Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
  • Experience with defect and delivery tooling (e.g., Jira/Confluence or equivalents).
  • Strong communication and influencing skills across multiple teams/time zones.

/WX/LP

Job Summary

Business Analyst Hiring Requirement

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join the Trading Control Technology team, supporting the delivery of strategic platforms and controls across Financial Markets. The successful candidate will translate business priorities into clear, testable requirements; partner with business, operations, product, engineering, architecture and control stakeholders; and help drive simplification, control uplift and delivery execution across trade validation, trade control and exception management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Front Office, MO & Operations, Risk, Compliance and Technology stakeholders to understand trading risk control priorities, exception management pain points and control uplift requirements across Financial Markets.
  • Capture, analyse and document business requirements for trade validation, trade lifecycle controls, exception detection, workflow routing, escalation, remediation and auditability.
  • Translate control objectives into clear user stories, process flows, data requirements, acceptance criteria and testable control outcomes for engineering delivery teams.
  • Analyse exception themes, root causes and operational impacts to support prioritisation of control enhancements, automation opportunities and simplification of manual processes.
  • Define and maintain current-state and target-state process maps covering trade capture, validation, exception queues, resolution ownership, escalation paths and management information.
  • Work with control owners and technology teams to ensure solutions strengthen risk visibility, prevent control gaps, reduce aged exceptions and improve end-to-end traceability.
  • Support design of dashboards, operational metrics and control reporting to monitor exception volumes, ageing, breach trends, remediation progress and service effectiveness.
  • Coordinate business validation, system integration testing and user acceptance testing for trading control and exception management changes, ensuring scenarios reflect real trading and operational risk events.
  • Prepare business readiness materials, operating model documentation, user guidance and training content to support adoption by Operations, Control and Technology support teams.
  • Contribute to governance forums, delivery planning and issue resolution by providing clear analysis, decision options, risks, dependencies and progress updates.

Key stakeholders

  • Markets Technology teams
  • Markets Business Heads, COO & CPOs
  • Markets Operations Team
  • Markets Architects

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in Financial Markets; Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures; Multiple functions (double hats);

Skills And Experience

  • Software Product Business Knowledge
  • Business Analysis
  • Requirements Management
  • Software Product Design/Architecture
  • Product Design

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

Technical and Domain Expertise

  • 8+ years of Business Analysis experience, with substantial exposure to Financial Markets initiatives
  • Proven ability to engage business users and stakeholders, and to deliver in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
  • Strong capability to translate business needs into clear functional requirements, user stories, and high-quality documentation.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to requirement analysis and solution design.
  • Solid understanding of Agile principles and delivery processes (e.g. Scrum/Kanban).
  • Strong data literacy, including hands-on SQL and experience working with enterprise databases (e.g. PostgreSQL or similar).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with strong written and spoken English.
  • Self-driven and accountable, with the ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.

Preferred Requirements

  • Broader Financial Markets domain knowledge across front, middle, and back-office processes.
  • Experience with DevOps practices, and collaboration in cross-functional product teams.
  • Cross-functional background in adjacent roles such as development, QA/testing, or product ownership.
  • Familiarity with process modelling and documentation frameworks (e.g. BPMN, UML).
  • Experience working across global teams and multiple time zones.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g. CFA).

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

  • Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think critically and creatively.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

Job Summary

Scope of Role

  • The role holder will be responsible for the budget volume of CMPS business and therefore to establish an agenda of the top business and plan to address the same.

工作范围

岗位人员将负责完成资本市场产品及解决方案部业务目标，开立业务议程并计划及执行其解决方案。

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities (Sales Role)

  • Ensure the Provision of FX and Structured Products transactions execution for our retail clients.
  • Responsible to achieve FX and Structured Products revenue budget
  • Provide timely markets outlook as well as FX and Structured Products advice solution and deal placement based on customer financial objectives and needs
  • Grow net-new-money to the bank through providing investment advisory focus on CMPS products to NTB & ETB customer.
  • Increase CMPS product penetration rate and Promotion digital platforms for Retail clients.
  • Use the framework of asset allocation to execute the financial plan for each NTB/ETB client to grow NTP number and optimize portfolio look. Responsible for branch sales strategy formulation, sales momentum tracking and business target review on CMPS products.
  • Comply with all procedures, policies and sales process of the bank
  • Comply with all applicable money laundering prevention procedures and, in particular, report any suspicious activity to the Unit Money Laundering Prevention Officer and line manager.

主要责任(销售岗)

  • 确保为我们的零售客户提供外汇和结构性产品交易执行服务。
  • 负责实现外汇和结构性产品收入预算
  • 根据客户的财务目标和需求，及时提供市场前景以及外汇和结构性产品建议方案及交易执行
  • 通过优质的外汇和结构性产品顾问服务来帮助银行客户的净新资金增长
  • 增加本部门产品渗透率并为零售客户提供推广数字平台。

  • 遵守银行的所有程序，政策和销售流程
  • 遵守所有适用的反洗钱程序，尤其是将任何可疑活动报告给部门反洗钱预防官和直属经理。

Strategy

  • Provide CMPS product coverage for Retail Banking (RB) clients
  • Deliver treasury revenue target through active marketing and advisory of Treasury products to clients.
  • Comply with all applicable Bank’s internal policies and external laws and regulation.

战略

  • 覆盖零售银行客户提供资本市场产品及解决方案部的产品。
  • 向客户提供市场资讯及资金产品方案与建议，并完成资金收入目标。
  • 遵守所有适用的银行内部政策以及外部法律法规。

Business

  • Responsibilities related to the delivery of business and / or financial objectives, for example, Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates

Processes

  • Reference the processes for which the Role Holder is responsible, as per the Operational Risk Framework definition of first / second line, for example, Responsible for executing and supervising the Budget process

People & Talent

  • Reference all responsibilities related to people and talent matters, for example:
  • Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from their team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing training and development of people, and ensure that holders of all critical functions are suitably skilled and qualified for their roles ensuring that they have effective supervision in place to mitigate any risks.
  • Employ, engage and retain high quality people, with succession planning for critical roles.
  • Responsibility to review team structure/capacity plans.
  • Set and monitor job descriptions and objectives for direct reports and provide feedback and rewards in line with their performance against those responsibilities and objectives.

Risk Management

  • Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties.
  • Comply with the respective Money Laundering Prevention Procedures and be alert at all times to unusual or possibly suspicious customer activity and should report any suspicious activity to AML Surveillance Team and line manager as well as directly to the Country MLPO in urgent or exceptional circumstances.
  • Mitigation of risks and resolution of issues in a timely manner including developing suitable controls and measuring their effectiveness.
  • Proactive identification and reporting of risks and concerns.

风险管理

  • 在履行职责时负责实施和遵守反洗钱要求。
  • 遵守相应的反洗钱预防程序，并始终对异常或可能可疑的客户活动保持警惕，并应将任何可疑活动报告给反洗钱办公室、直属经理，并在紧急或特殊情况下直接报告给中国反洗钱总监。
  • 及时减轻风险和解决问题，包括制定适当的控制措施和衡量其有效性。

主动识别和报告风险和疑虑。

Governance

监管

  • 遵守法律法规，内部风险和合规政策（包括反洗钱，制裁，反贿赂和腐败以及相关的FCC风险）和《集团行为准则》。

  • 充分了解消费者权益保护的重要性，防止损害消费者的最大利益，执行与消费者权益保护相关的法规要求，确保完成相关培训并在执行日常工作时始终嵌入消费者权益保护心态。
  • 充分了解预防欺诈的重要性，预防欺诈风险，保持职位安全稳定的运行，执行预防欺诈的法规要求，严格执行部门的DOI，确保完成相关培训并将预防欺诈纳入日常工作

  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies
  • 理解、认同并遵守本地法律法规以及渣打内部政策中关于个人问责和职责的要求；
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities
  • 跟上本地问责法律法规的发展，以有效地确保并强化内控；
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank
  • 审慎勤勉地履行岗位职责，以个人或团队成员的身份，为避免任何导致银行遭受或可能遭受法律制裁、监管处罚、重大财务损失或声誉负面影响而做出努力；
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections
  • 对未遵守相关规范和流程、未适当履行职责以及未执行整改措施承担相应责任；
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review
  • 配合任何关于违反监管规定的调查或审查，例如，问责审查。

Accountable For Consumer Rights Protection Requirements (CN Required)

  • Fully comply with all the regulatory requirements related to Consumer Rights Protection, uphold the robust mindset of Consumer Rights Protection, complete the Consumer Rights Protection themed training and workshop in due course, prevent the potential infringements of consumer rights, participate the public education, EV or other activities to uplift the public awareness about Consumer Rights Protection.

  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Job Description

Lead with impact as the Country Lead for Document and Business Solutions (DBS) Operations in China, heading a team that keeps the firm's critical document and records services running securely, accurately, and on time. As AI and new technologies transform our organization, you will help move DBS from a paper-based operation to a digital, AI-assisted capability with controls built into every process. Working with our main internal clients, including the Investment Bank, Operations, and Events and Marketing, as well as partners across risk and technology, you will drive operational excellence and deliver scalable solutions that support the firm's growth. This is an opportunity to shape how our operations run day to day, in a culture that values innovation, leadership, and diversity.

Job Responsibilities

  • Execute the China DBS strategy and roadmap, covering service scope, digitization, modernization, capacity, and location strategy. Align it with regional and global DBS direction, and track the benefits it delivers.
  • Lead a team of 14 across Shanghai and Beijing covering our services in 8 China sites. Set goals, coach leaders, and build succession plans, training, and cross-coverage for critical processes. Help teams build skills in digital tools, analytics, and automation operations.
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across the Investment Bank, Operations, Events and Marketing, CAO functions, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Technology. Understand their priorities, set clear expectations, and turn business needs into prioritized deliverables. Balance competing demands, manage escalations, and influence decisions where you don't have direct authority.
  • Own the annual budget, headcount, productivity commitments, and cost-to-serve. Deliver savings through demand management, process re-engineering, standardization, and supplier negotiations.
  • Own end-to-end service performance across sites, including turnaround times, quality, exceptions, rework, and backlog. Support this with capacity and peak planning and resilience coverage.
  • Ensure our print centres run seamlessly and delivery is within SLA's
  • Maintain the service catalog, SOPs, quality assurance sampling, and control testing routines, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Lead incident and escalation management, using structured root-cause analysis and lasting corrective actions to reduce repeat incidents.
  • Ensure chain-of-custody integrity and traceability for physical and digital documents through receipt, storage, handover, retrieval, and destruction, with evidence that is ready for audit.
  • Apply strict change control to workflow, tooling, and routing changes. Partner with Operational Risk, Compliance, Control, and Technology Risk to assess new services, changes, and material incidents.
  • Modernize paper-based processes through scanning, LLM, metadata tagging, classification, and automated routing. Integrate DBS services with enterprise workflow and records platforms.
  • Lead the rollout and ongoing operation of intelligent document processing (IDP), robotic process automation (RPA), and GenAI-enabled document handling. Set human review standards, including exception queues, quality sampling, override rules, and monitoring for quality and model drift.
  • Manage outsourced services and vendors. This covers SLA and KPI scorecards, governance reviews, onboarding and due diligence, performance remediation, concentration risk, and exit readiness.
  • Serve as the senior DBS contact for country business heads, CAO functions, Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Technology. Attend governance forums and report on performance, risks, and roadmap progress with clear metrics.

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management. Able to explain the vision and strategy clearly and influence people you don't manage. Ability to market our services to other functions.
  • Proven ability to lead through change and to build a culture of continuous improvement and learning from missteps.
  • 8 years of experience in Operations
  • Strong knowledge of operational risk and controls, records and information governance, audit readiness, data privacy, and the expectations of a regulated environment.
  • Proven track record in service transformation, digitization, standardization, and cost and productivity management.
  • Expertise in process innovation, design, and automation
  • Proven vendor management and commercial skills, including budgeting, negotiations, and SLA governance.
  • Data-driven management skills, including KPI design, dashboards, and root-cause analysis.

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Experience rolling out AI or large language model (LLM), IDP, or RPA solutions in regulated workflows, including governance of human review steps.
  • Experience in a product environment or a global organization focused on banking processes.
  • Knowledge of China's data protection requirements, such as PIPL, the Data Security Law, and the Cybersecurity Law.
  • Fluent spoken and written English and Mandarin.

ABOUT US

J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

About The Team

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Proactively manage a complex portfolio of clients, becoming a trusted advisor to lead strategic dialogues with clients at a portfolio level through the understanding of specific business requirements and delivering creative and flexible customer solutions
  • To hand over customer relationship properly to their relationship managers after closing sales
  • To provide excellent services to customers and ensure all enquiries and complaints are accurately and effectively resolved to customers' satisfaction- To participate actively in team building activities to share information/ideas while contributing suggestions for work improvement- Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • University degree or above (recognized by the state)
  • Strong interpersonal skills and effective presentation skills
  • Well-developed service and sales attitude with ability to work under pressure- Presentable, Outgoing and Persuasive- Good oral and written English is preferable

主要职责

  • 主要负责中高端客户的开发，向潜在客户介绍汇丰的服务，发掘关于银行服务的需求并发展为汇丰客户
  • 负责销售渠道的开发以及维护, 负责前期客户关系的维护和客户关系的交接
  • 为客户提供优良的服务，确保客户的询问得到准确有效的回复，提高客户满意度- 主动接洽合作渠道、持续跟踪潜在客户名单直至成功开户，完成银行设定的工作目标- 确保有高标准的专业知识，与潜在客户进行更好的沟通

岗位要求

  • 本科或以上学历(国家认可)；
  • 优秀的人际交往和有效的沟通技巧；- 能够在高压下工作，良好的服务和销售态度；- 得体, 外向和具有说服力；- 有良好的英语口语和书写能力
